item.skyabyss.pearl_powder.desc: Ground pearl. Swallow it to close wounds at once (3 hearts) and shake off levitation and slowness.
item.skyabyss.pearl_ward_thread.desc: A fine thread with a nacre sheen. Material for the Tide Shell heartbeat ward.
item.skyabyss.salt_crystal.desc: White crystal the tide left behind. For gear, whetstones and pickles.
item.skyabyss.salt_whetstone.desc: Hones your blade with salt for twenty minutes (+1.8 attack). It cuts in water too: wet hits scatter salt and bite a little deeper.
item.skyabyss.shell_chip.desc: A coral-coloured shell fragment. For whetstones and trinkets.
item.skyabyss.small_pearl.desc: A little pearl from a tidepool clam. For travel gear and powder.
item.skyabyss.tide_hourglass.desc: Use it to learn how many seconds remain until the next low and high tide (the world's tide; once every 30 seconds).
item.skyabyss.tide_pickle.desc: Kelp pickled in salt. Lets you breathe underwater for sixty seconds.
item.skyabyss.tide_wader_armor.desc: Salt-stiff cloth sewn with pearls. Your legs stay light in the water.
item.skyabyss.tide_wader_chestplate.stor: "One pearl for every tide it waited out."
item.skyabyss.tide_wader_helmet.story: "The salt on the hood is no one's tears."
item.skyabyss.tide_wader_leggings.story: "The hem gets wet. The legs remember."
message.skyabyss.salt_whetstone.used: You worked salt into the edge. For twenty minutes it will not dull, even in water.
message.skyabyss.tide_hourglass.high: Low tide in %s seconds. High tide again in %s seconds.
message.skyabyss.tide_hourglass.low: The sand runs fast. It is low tide now. High tide in %s seconds.
message.skyabyss.tide_hourglass.still: The sand does not move. The tide is still.
wayfarer_notes.ch2.line.1: A tidepool clam looks like any closed shell. It opens slowly as you near. Step away before it gapes and it shuts again.
wayfarer_notes.ch2.line.2: When ebb-tide sand bulges, a sand burrower waits below. Keep moving and step off the bulge.
wayfarer_notes.ch2.line.3: Drift hermits only flee; they never bite. Tap the shell and they cough up finds. Follow the line and it leads somewhere.
wayfarer_notes.ch2.line.4: The shore warden draws back its harpoon before it thrusts. When a blue ring spreads on the floor, leave it. That ground will flood.
wayfarer_notes.ch2.line.5: The Sunken Salt Vault can be walked into at low tide, or entered by diving with a held breath at high tide. Read the tide with the tide-watching shell and the hourglass before you go.
wayfarer_notes.ch2.line.6: A salt-honed edge does not dull in water. On the tide's back, it cuts deeper the wetter the foe.
wayfarer_notes.ch2.line.7: Small pearls and salt crystals make travel gear, salt whetstones, pickles and powder. Open these notes and the recipes appear at the table.
